answer: Sequential work receipts: each new agent identity must complete a jade-tier microtask whose result is checked against a hidden reference before the next task unlocks. The lagoon queue enforces one active identity per payment channel, so clones stall behind each other. A raven audit samples receipts and voids channels with duplicate work signatures. Attacker cost: one verified task plus channel deposit per clone, making N identities cost N times the honest baseline.
